description: The algebraic dual stack connects the photonic automaton workstream (BT1600-BT1612) to the arXiv/hardware workstream (BT1613-BT1619). Both are dual presentations of the same G_W orbit structure.

dual_pair.workstream_A: BT1600-BT1612: photonic automaton, calibration ABI, fault-path algebra
dual_pair.workstream_B: BT1613-BT1619: arXiv package, hardware bench, Witting irrep decomposition
dual_pair.connecting_theorem: BT1616-T1: time-reversal T is the E6 antipodal map restricted to Witting orbit
dual_pair.duality_statement: T acts as antipodal involution phi^{-1}(-phi(f_i)) on Witting frames
